english.html: there to be hanged and strangled on a gallows which shall be erected there for that purpose, and afterwards his body burnt. And for certain causes and considerations moving the Court thereto, it has adjudged and adjudges the goods of the said du Tilh to the daughter procreated by his doings and of the said de Rols, under pretext of the marriage by him falsely pretended, substituting the name and person of the said Martin Guerre and by this means deceiving the said de Rols — the costs of Justice deducted. And moreover, it has dismissed and dismisses from the case and suit the said Martin Guerre and Bertrande de Rols, together with the said Pierre Guerre, uncle of the said Martin: and has remanded and remands the same du Tilh to the said Judge of Rieux, to have this present decision put into execution according to its form and tenor.
Pronounced judicially, the twelfth day of September, 1560.
And the judgment appealed from, as null.

That from which appeal had been taken was the judgment of the Judge of Rieux, by which the same du Tilh was condemned to lose his head and afterwards to be put in four quarters; which was quashed by the Court, because this kind of death seemed to it, for so prodigious and abominable a traitor, heaped up with every kind of vice, [unclear: the print gives no predicate here — luy ſembloit pour vn ſi prodigieux … proditeur …; "too honourable" is evidently meant] singu

lines: pour illec en vne potence, qu'à ces fins y ſera
dreſſée, eſtre pendu, & eſtranglé, & apres ſon
corps bruſlé. Et pour certaines cauſes & conſi-
derations à ce mouuans la cour, elle à adiugé,
& adiuge les biens dudit du Tilh, à la fille pro
creée de ſes œuures, & de ladite de Rols, ſous pre
texte de mariage, par luy fauſſement pretendu,
ſuppoſant le nom, & perſonne dudit Martin
Guerre. & par ce moyen deceuãt ladite de Rols,
detraicts les frais de Iuſtice. Et en outre, a mis,
& met hors de procez, & inſtance leſdits Mar-
tin Guerre, & Bertrande de Rols, enſemble ledit
Pierre Guerre, oncle dudit Martin: & a renuoyé
& renuoye iceluy du Tilh audit Iuge de Rieux
pour faire mettre ce preſent arreſt à execution
ſelon ſa forme & teneur.
Prononce iudicialement, le xij. iour
de Septembre, 1560.

french.text: Et ce dont a eſté appelé, au neant.

lines: Ce dont auoit eſté appelé, eſtoit la ſentence du Iuge
de Rieux, par laquelle iceluy du Tilh eſtoit condam-
né perdre la teſte, & apres eſtre mis en quatre quartiers
qui fut caſſée par la cour, par ce que ceſte eſpece de
mort luy ſembloit pour vn ſi prodigieux, & abomina-
ble proditeur comblé en toute eſpece de vices, ſingulie
